Name: Esmerelda The Witch
Author: Billybob8001
Description:
[center]Adds a brand-new NPC, Esmerelda the Witch! Complete with a rich backstory and a charmingly magical personality, she blends seamlessly into the vanilla game. Includes full dialogue, a custom schedule, and unique events.

[b]Gift List
[/b]Loves: Jade, Midnight Carp, Oil of Garlic, Life Elixir, Strange Bun, Void Salmon, Tea Leaves
Likes: Ancient Doll, Strange Doll (Yellow), Strange Doll (Green), Pumpkin, Holly, Hops, Red Mushroom, Mead, Bat Wing
Neutral: Animal Products, Artisan Goods, And Most Gems
Dislikes: Wild Horseradish, Cave Carrot, Cactus Fruit, Void Egg, Void Mayonaise
Hates: Super Cucumber, Purple Mushroom, Void Essence, Solar Essence
[u]Her Birthday is the 28th of Fall![/u]
﻿
[b]﻿Heart Events
[/b]2 Heart Event: Witch's Swamp
4 Heart Event: In the Mountains - 9:00 pm - 2:00 am - Must be Raining.
6 Heart Event: Witch's Hut - Must be Sunny.
8 Heart Event: Witch's Hut
10 Heart Event: Cindrersnap Forest 6:00 pm - 9:00 pm must enter through south of farm - Must be Sunny.

[b]Compatability
[/b]Esmerelda has not been tested for compatibility with SDVE, East Scarp, Ridgeside Village, or any other Witch NPC mods. If anyone want to test it out and let me know that would be great! One know conflict is anything that overrides the sprite of the nighttime Witch flyover event.


[b]Upcoming Features
[/b]Quests, Potions, New Expansion..., And More!
Please let me know if you have any ideas for future updates, compatibility, or translations. Any feedback is appreciated!


[b]Special Thanks To[/b]
The Stardew Valley Wiki for their [url=http://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Index]Modding Index[/url]﻿﻿!
Poltergeister and Tarniyar for hat and frog assets![/center]
